title: wpm audit verdict schema — version 1
description: Contract for the JSON emitted by wpm audit (simd_token_replay). All consumers MUST read these exact keys. No consumer may fall back to 0.0 on key absence without explicit documentation.
invariant: No court verdict may silently degrade to zero through key mismatch. CICD-WPM-004.

overall_fitness.description: Aggregate token replay fitness across all traces. Threshold: TRUTHFUL >= 0.95, VARIANCE >= 0.70, DECEPTIVE < 0.70.

total_consumed.description: Sum of tokens consumed across all trace replays

total_produced.description: Sum of tokens produced across all trace replays

total_missing.description: Sum of tokens inserted to force-fire transitions with empty presets

total_remaining.description: Sum of tokens left in non-sink places after trace ends

precision.description: NOT COMPUTED by simd_token_replay. Always null. Future: will be computed when a reference model is provided.

precision_note.description: Human-readable explanation of why precision is null

missing.description: Missing tokens — NEVER read as missing_tokens

remaining.description: Remaining tokens — NEVER read as remaining_tokens

consumer_contract.precision_handling: precision is null — display as UNSUPPORTED, never as 0.0000
consumer_contract.key_mismatch_invariant: If overall_fitness key is absent, verdict MUST be UNKNOWN not DECEPTIVE(0.0)
